entries.title: VS Code v1_141: Enterprise
entries.description: Migration of legacy VS Code policies to Agent Host managed settings The Copilot harness, powered by the Copilot SDK and running in VS Code's Agent Host, is gradually becoming the default for enterprise users who have VS Code experiments enabled. To preserve existing enterprise controls during this transition, VS Code translates supported legacy policies into unified managed settings at runtime when possible. This translation applies to sessions on the same machine and does not change your policy

entries.title: VS Code v1_141: Authentication
entries.description: Sign in to multiple GitHub Enterprise instances Setting:github-enterprise.urisOpen in VS CodeOpen in VS Code Insiders Many organizations use GitHub Copilot through a GHE.com account but keep their code on GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES). Thegithub-enterprise.urisetting held a single instance, so you couldn't be signed in to both at once. For example, you couldn't use Copilot with your GHE.com account and review pull requests on GHES in the same VS Code window.

entries.title: VS Code v1_141: Agent environments
entries.description: Continue local external Copilot sessions without reloading New conversations from the Copilot CLI and GitHub Copilot app are now picked up automatically as external sessions as soon as you send the first request, even when the Agents window is already open. You can open and continue these conversations directly from the Agents window. Use theCreated InandCreated Externallyfilters to choose which conversations appear in the sessions list.

entries.title: VS Code v1_141: Agent loop
entries.description: Copilot harness The Copilot harness adds exciting new agent functionality to VS Code. It's powered by the Copilot SDK, so its behavior and capabilities are consistent with other Copilot products, including the standalone GitHub Copilot app and the Copilot CLI. To start using the Copilot harness, select it from the harness picker in the chat input. In this release, it might already be the default selection for you. You can continue working as you normally do.
